summary: Parses a .hdv vehicle file into a session struct, then accumulates a set of parameter values into the caller's output dword via repeated UtilityFunction_8a60 selector calls (using the selector byte at this+0x1), adds the tyre-model data contribution, frees all parsed-data allocations, and returns an AND-combined success flag (zeroed whenever any selector call fails, but parsing continues).

local_names.a3: output accumulator dword (sum of parsed values)
local_names.v4: combined success flag (starts 1, cleared on any failed selector call)

operations.description: Set the success flag v4 = 1, initialize the local session struct via SessionStructInit and scratch tyre-model data via TireModelDataInit.
Parse the vehicle .hdv file a2 into the session struct via TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser(a2, v13, 2), then zero the output accumulator (*a3 = 0).
Accumulate six parameter values: repeatedly call UtilityFunction_8a60(this[1], &v6); on a non-zero return add v6 to *a3, otherwise clear v4; then add the tyre-model contribution v7[2] to *a3.
Free all parsed-data allocations: v12, v11, v10, v9, v8, v7[0] and v14 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and the score/timing scratch v15 via ScoreSlotDeallocator.
Return the combined success flag v4 (1 only if every UtilityFunction_8a60 call succeeded). Invoked from sub_45C0C0 and ParticleSoundEffectSpawner.
